summary: Iteration 4 — Validated email/phone gates for /api/connect. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests pass (9 prior + 5 new). Frontend: both ExclusiveAccess popup and ContactPage show inline errors for invalid phone/email, block submission, then submit successfully after correction. No documents persisted for rejected submissions. Test artifacts cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses os.environ[...] for required env at import time — good fail-fast; consistent with guidelines.
EMAIL_RE regex is a reasonable practical pattern; matches frontend regex used in ExclusiveAccess/ContactPage — parity between client and server enforced.
Phone validation strips non-digits and requires 7–15 digits — permissive and international-friendly.

Consider returning FastAPI-style structured errors (list of {loc,msg,type}) if frontend later needs per-field mapping; currently detail is a plain string, which the frontend derives client-side (works fine).
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test connect_inquiries during e2e (test_popup_e2e@example.com, test_contact_e2e@example.com) — both deleted post-test. Confirmed rejected emails ('not-an-email', 'bad@@email') never persisted.
context_for_next_testing_agent:

under fields inside popup/contact-form containers. data-testids: popup-{name,phone,email,consent,submit}, contact-{name,phone,email,consent,submit}. Reminder: email_sent may be false for JamesAGreen@eXpRealty.com due to Resend cool-down — NOT a regression.
